newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Highlands to sell Porgera stake - papers say.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Highlands to sell Porgera stake - papers say.

text.p: Highlands Gold Ltd planned to make a capital return to all shareholders with the exception of Placer Dome Inc and spin-off a new company that would hold all its assets with the exception of the Porgera gold mine in Papua New Guinea, the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper said on Monday.
The holding in Porgera, in which Highlands and Placer each have a 25 percent stake, could be acquired by Placer subject to the Canadian company offering the right price, the paper said.
Placer has a 44 percent stake in Highlands and has made a hostile 75 cents per share bid for the company.
The newspaper said Highlands would seek A$310 million to A$320 million for the Porgera stake, at least A$13 million than Porgera had offered.
It said Highlands shares not owned by Placer Dome would be cancelled in exchange for a capital return of 65 cents per share and a share in the new group, Highlands Pacific.
Brokerage firms McIntosh and Wilson HTM are believed to be working on the sale of Placer's entitlement and an underwritten capital raising of up to A$80 million.
The Australian Financial Review newspaper said Highlands had asked Placer to formally respond to the proposals by Tuesday.
